### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Root: closing the payout account (customer's own write, user tool).

- **Hop 1 — final card load waits on an instant cashout dated the closing day (state-derived).** closure_disbursement_account_closing_terms 2.1: "On a card plan, the final card load is fixed only after the account carries an instant cashout dated the day of closing." Restated in 2.3 in record terms. Records: no instant cashout entry dated 2026-10-03 (none at all). The write that brings it about was found with the words "instant cashout" and "Everyday Pay Card": card_cashout_desk_reference ("the cashout is booked as an instant cashout entry on the shopper's payout account, dated the day it is made"). This is the card cashout, owned by the shopper.
- **Hop 2 — the closing waits on the closing cashback settlement having been paid (state-derived / action-worded).** 2.2: "A card-plan account is not closed until the closing cashback settlement has been paid onto the card." Records: the 2026-09 month carries no payment. closing_cashback_settlement_tool_reference describes the settlement ("the cashback of the latest statement month that carries no payment and whose payment day has not yet come is paid onto the card at the closing … booked … as a cashback payment carrying that statement month"). The sentence names the settlement by its business name as a completed state; I mark it state-derived, because the depended-on document had to be found by that name and the records checked.
- **Hop 3 — the closing settlement waits on the statement payment owed (action-worded).** closing_cashback_settlement_tool_reference: "The closing cashback settlement is fixed only after the statement payment owed for the months whose payment day has passed, where one is owed, has been made." Records plus statement_cashback_payment_amount S.3–S.5 show a payment is owed for 2026-08 (due 71.40 ≥ 1.00; no payment carries 2026-08). The write is found in statement_cashback_payments_desk_reference ("A statement payment falls due when a statement month's payment day has come and the card still holds cashback earned and not yet paid"). Whether one is owed had to be worked out from S.3–S.5 and the records.
- Direction and order: statement payment → closing settlement → close; card cashout → close. No other visible prerequisite sentence applies (the card cashout and the statement payment carry none).
- Hop marks: hops 1–3 were each derived from a prerequisite sentence, the depended-on document and the records. None was pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool, route or chain.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only what was asked" (hand over the closing at once with the baseline figure): excluded by clauses 2.1/2.2. The account shows no instant cashout dated the closing day and no settlement for 2026-09, so the final card load has no fixed figure and the card-plan account is not closed under the visible rule.
- Settle the closing cashback before the statement payment: excluded by the timing sentence. The closing share tier also changes (2 payments → no raised share → 0.5 share: 60.00 × 0.5 × 1.05 = 31.50 + 1.575 → 33.08, versus 66.15).
- The statement payment carrying 2026-09: excluded by S.3/S.6, since 2026-09 is still waiting on 10-03 (2 days < 4). It carries 2026-08.
- Closing settlement for 2026-08: excluded because the closing clause settles the latest month with earned entries whose payment day has not come (2026-09). 2026-08's payment day has passed and it is paid by the statement payment.
- Transfer to human / refuse: not applicable, since every step is covered by visible policy.
- Fall-back numbers: statement payment 60.00, closing settlement 26.80, card cashout 168.85, final disbursement 63.30. Each differs from the answer reached (82.75, 66.15, 81.25, 53.05). Every factor was found from record words: "Cartwise+ Premier Annual", "base pay", "long distance" (pay component long_distance), "activated_date", "plan_changed_date", "level_evaluated_date", "violation points", "pay reversal", "earnings debit", "rating 1". None of the computation documents hints at a modifier.
- Visible-text inconsistencies noticed (carried to the scan): facet_closing_disbursement_terms 9.1 states as a clause in force that "The remaining balance of a closed payout account is paid by the plan's closing disbursement method within the plan's final disbursement period". payout_account_closing_terms B.2 declares that former clause "no longer in force". facet_card_cashback_rate_card lists "Unpaid cashback lapses when the account closes: Yes" as a setting, while the cashback terms 3.3 retire the lapse clause and the closing clause settles the month. Neither changes a number in this task.
